method.controller_comparison: Identical realized demand, source, prices, component ratings, source interlocks, shared network and backup, storage efficiencies, community contracts; every first action validated against exact original physics.
method.rule: Original instantaneous economic gate + proportional allocation, extended only for shared constraints/community priority. No future input.
method.forecast: Causal models issue each hour, 24-hour optimization, only first action executes, observations and SOC update before reissuing.
method.perfect_information: Same rolling optimizer with realized future; anticipative benchmark. Finite horizon, MILP envelopes and exact recourse mean its realized margin is not mathematically guaranteed to dominate.
method.true_upper_bound: A separate perfect-information lossless-network relaxed LP supplies an honest margin ceiling; it is not physically executable or a fair controller.
method.terminal: Every independent window opens with 0 MWh. All controllers close at 0 MWh; any residual storage is explicitly rejected with no sale/salvage credit. No annualization.
method.normalization: Percentage delta divided by absolute baseline operating margin, omitted if baseline is zero. USD delta is primary.
method.operator_boundary: Thermal sales less incremental heat electricity, variable O&M, source royalty, community contribution. Retained customer backup cost reported separately; CAPEX/fixed O&M/debt/tax absent. Margin is not project profit.
method.customer_savings_baseline: Delivered heat times original assumed avoided-heat tariff minus HeatCo thermal tariff. Unserved demand produces no avoided-cost or carbon credit.
method.outage_information: Unannounced outages are unavailable to forecasting until observed; deterministic execution recourse sees current observations equally for all controllers.

input_hash_verification: Model and dataset hashes inspected before service construction and unchanged at successful run completion; source files recorded independently.
